thread:
anya: Quick heads-up — Agency CTP pilot hit a hard blocker: they require mutual-TLS to the gov gateway + SAML federated SSO + an approved CA chain for client certs. Procurement also pushed for committed throughput pricing before their board sign-off. @michael can you confirm SE plan?

michael: On it. Short notes: mTLS termination in our private control plane (VPC) looks easiest for their network team, but we need a cert rotation story and acceptance of our CA. They explicitly said no public CAs.

raj: I prototyped a tiny TLS proxy that can present an agency-supplied client cert to the gateway and route traffic to our runtime in the VPC. Paste: ```
server {
  listen 443 ssl;
  ssl_certificate /etc/agency/client.pem;
  proxy_pass https://internal-redwood:8443;
}
```

anya: Nice, raj. Can you stash that in the POC repo and add a README for ops? This helps the gov security review.

lucy: Legal note — the agency's security questionnaire Q12 asks for key custody details. They expect BYOK or HSM-backed custody with audit logs. We'll need SOC2 + attestation for key handling.

security-bot: Security checklist: IL4/IL5 constraints flagged. No internet egress from runtime subnets allowed, KMS BYO required, and FIPS-validated crypto for keys in transit.

sophia: From GTM: customer needs pricing options: (A) 6-month reserved throughput with 20% discount, (B) pay-as-you-go with burst. They want committed numbers to present at a steering committee next week. @anya do we have margin calc?

michael: Actionable items I'm taking: 1) Draft network diagram for private control plane -> agency gateway by EOD today. 2) Confirm cert rotation cadence and support for agency-supplied certs. 3) Validate that our runtime has zero egress option.

anya: I'll coordinate the steering committee invite. Proposed sync: Thu 15:00 PT with Agency SSO + their infra lead. Can everyone confirm availability?

raj: I can do Thu 15:00 PT. I'll show the proxy demo and airflow for cert rotation.

lucy: I need the security questionnaire answers by Thu morning to prep the legal cover.

security-bot: Flagged ticket created: SEC-POC-721. Required docs: key custody spec, network diagram, attestation letter.

sophia: Pricing ask: @finance — need a committed throughput quote for 500k tokens/day and 2k concurrent sessions. If we offer reserved tier, what's the delta vs burst? Need draft by Fri COB.

anya: Summary / next steps: - Michael: network diagram + cert rotation doc (EOD today) - Raj: push proxy demo + README (tomorrow AM) - Lucy: finalize Q12/legal language (Thu AM) - Sophia/Finance: draft committed throughput pricing (Fri COB) - I’ll run Thu 15:00 PT sync with agency. If anyone hits a blocker ping me directly. :thumbsup:

michael: Noted. If agency insists on on-prem control plane we need to scope extra ops hours — will surface in the sync.

anya: Thanks team. I'll open a short status channel and drop the steering invite.
